acceptance_predicates.description: Credential-free CI covers setup, discovery, run, bounded sweep, results, comparison, cancellation, reset, and cleanup through public surfaces.
A separately authorized live Codex OAuth qualification records only redacted and digest-bound evidence.
Listener, substitution, key, response, timeout, crash, orphan, restart, concurrency, and redaction faults are exercised.
User guidance clearly distinguishes the local key, upstream OAuth, quota/cost, reset/revocation, and development-only limitations.

definition_of_done: Full fake qualification and fault matrix are terminal green.
Opt-in live evidence is either green and redacted or explicitly unavailable without blocking credential-free CI.
Independent review, exact-head checks, merge, and post-merge checks pass.

outputs.description: Development-only cli2key qualification receipt and user documentation.

gates.description: The public credential-free journey is complete and reproducible.
No generated key or OAuth material appears in any durable or diagnostic surface.
Independent exact-head review and required pre/post-merge CI pass.
